discovery.description: Resolve a supplied Pennsylvania company name to one unique strong Department of State legal entity, verify the supplied domain through authoritative RDAP, require legal-name/domain alignment, require days until expiration at/above minExpirationDays, and require days since the authoritative lastChanged event at/above minStableDays. Returns stable_domain or human_review. This is a continuity/timing workflow signal only and does not prove ownership, renewal, uninterrupted service, security, fraud risk, compromise, malicious activity, good standing, authority, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania vendor to a unique legal entity, verify legal-name/domain alignment through authoritative RDAP, require sufficient expiration runway, and require that the authoritative domain lastChanged event is old enough for automated continuation. Returns stable_domain or human_review. This is a continuity/timing workflow signal, not proof of ownership, safety, fraud risk, security, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Review whether a prospective Pennsylvania vendor's legal-name-aligned domain has sufficient expiration runway and has not changed too recently for automated continuation.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independently verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not treat synthetic fixtures, public discovery or HTTP 200 as sales.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Require one unique strong PA entity and an authoritative registered domain aligned to the resolved legal name.
Require expiration runway of at least minExpirationDays and lastChanged age of at least minStableDays.
Incomplete evidence or policy failures produce human_review; stability is not proof of ownership, safety or continuity guarantees.
stable_domain is a continuity/timing workflow signal only
expiration runway does not guarantee renewal or uninterrupted service
lastChanged recency does not by itself establish compromise, ownership transfer, malicious activity, or fraud
legal-name/domain alignment does not prove domain ownership or control
a Pennsylvania registry match does not prove good standing, ownership, authority, creditworthiness, or legal compliance

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.

criteria: Existing exact-revision release gate and deterministic tests must pass before a reviewed deployment.
Independently verify authoritative-source availability, payment identity, and current facilitator fee/allowance terms.
Commercial release remains blocked until true hosting/source/refund economics and independently verified customer demand are established.
